name: purpose-box
description: Two bold lines at the bottom of every reply - why you asked this, and why this session exists - so you never lose the thread across many chats.

plugins.name: purpose-box
plugins.description: Ends every reply with a two-row bold box - PURPOSE (why the user asked this) and SESSION (why the whole conversation exists) - in the shortest plain sentence possible, so you never lose the thread across many chats. Installs the skill, plus a one-time /purpose-box-setup command that writes the always-on rules file.
